description: Verify that Multicast/unicast reboot tracker — DUT Acks lower-sid Subscribe after reboot
approach:
[Objective]
Reboot detection: a SD message with a session_id lower than the previous one signals reboot — DUT honours subsequent Subscribes from the rebooted peer.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Subscribe #1 → Ack.
3. Subscribe #2 → Ack.
4. Reboot signal (lower sid) + Subscribe #3 → Ack.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked subscribes across reboot — normal
